Effective July 1, 2018, Premium Managed Disks customers will be migrated to new GUIDs.

“Premium Storage - Page Blobs” will be migrated to the “Premium Managed Disks” GUIDs. All other disk characteristics (for example, pricing, regional availability, and capabilities) will remain the same. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you might need to modify billing routines that rely on names or resource GUIDs.
